subject: Approval request: Private Observability Minimum Pack — scope + resourcing + cross-team owners
related_links: Confluence: ADR-021 Private observability minimum pack scope
body:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Aug 1, 2025 at 9:12 AM PT
Subject: Approval request: Private Observability Minimum Pack — scope + resourcing + cross-team owners

Priya,

Requesting approval to lock scope + staffing for the “Private observability minimum pack” (VPC + on-prem). We’re at the point where we need explicit cross-team ownership and time allocation to hit the Private GA readiness bar.

Why now:
- Private deals are stalling on “supported day-2 ops” (baseline dashboards/alerts/log export) and Support is spending cycles on bespoke setups.
- We have multiple customer escalations tied to Prometheus/Grafana wiring + alert noise + missing offline artifacts.

Proposed v1 deliverable (supported minimum):
1) Versioned bundle shipped with private installer/Helm:
   - Grafana dashboards (runtime + control plane + infra)
   - Prometheus alerts + recording rules for golden signals + GPU/resource pressure
2) Supported log pipeline defaults:
   - structured logs, safe redaction guidance, default retention
   - export configs documented/tested for at least Splunk HEC + Elasticsearch/OpenSearch (and “generic HTTP/OTLP” as best-effort)
3) Validation + runbooks:
   - smoke tests and an on-prem/air-gap validation plan
   - Support runbooks with runbook links embedded in alert annotations

What I need approval on (resourcing + owners):
- Telemetry/Observability Eng: 2 FTE for ~6 weeks
  - Metrics/rules/dashboards packaging + log pipeline defaults
- Private Deployments Eng: 1 FTE for ~4–5 weeks
  - installer preflight/postinstall validation + offline bundle packaging
- SRE/Obs: 0.5 FTE for ~4 weeks
  - alert severity mapping, noise tuning, validation in staging/private reference env
- Security review: 0.2–0.3 FTE in week 3–5
  - log content/redaction + retention defaults sign-off

I’m attaching the one-pager + draft RACI. If you approve today, we’ll lock the project plan next week with Program (Talia) and start execution immediately.

Attachments:
- Private-Observability-Min-Pack_Scope-Resourcing_2025-08-01.pdf
- Private-Obs-Min-Pack_RACI_v0.3.xlsx

Thanks,
Vivek
Product Lead, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference


---

From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Aug 1, 2025 at 10:04 AM PT
Subject: Re: Approval request: Private Observability Minimum Pack — scope + resourcing + cross-team owners

Vivek,

Aligned on doing this and on the “minimum supported” framing.

Before I approve the full staffing ask, I need two clarifications in writing (reply-all is fine):
1) What is the hard line on v1 scope vs v2? (I want a clean list of explicit non-goals so we don’t pull in premium asks mid-stream.)
2) Confirm the named DRI(s) for each area and what’s actually shipping in the installer vs “documented integration.”

Also: make sure we’re not introducing high-cardinality metrics by default in customer clusters (I’ve seen us get burned here). Put explicit guardrails in the plan.

Once you send those, I’ll reply with resourcing approval and we’ll slot it into the next planning cycle.

Priya
Exec Sponsor, Platform Engineering


---

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Aug 1, 2025 at 12:21 PM PT
Subject: Re: Approval request: Private Observability Minimum Pack — scope + resourcing + cross-team owners

Thanks Priya — clarifications below.

1) v1 scope hard lines (explicit non-goals):
- No “observability premium” features: long retention (>14d), multi-cluster federation, custom per-customer dashboards, or advanced tracing sampling controls.
- No new SIEM platform. We only ship baseline log collection + documented/tested exports.
- No requirement to mirror Hosted/Dedicated Console parity. This is a Private-supported baseline for day-2 ops.

2) DRIs + what ships vs what’s documented:
- Dashboards + alert rules bundle (ships in installer/Helm):
  - Telemetry DRI: Logan Wright (implementation); authoring support: Sergio Costa (dashboards/alerts)
  - Contents: runtime overview, control plane health, GPU fleet panels; SLO-ish burn alerts + saturation/OOM/restarts.

- Log pipeline defaults (ships + documented export configs):
  - Telemetry DRI: Logan Wright
  - Ships: collector config with parsing, batching/backpressure defaults, redaction-safe guidance, retention defaults
  - Documented + tested “supported exports”: Splunk HEC and Elasticsearch/OpenSearch (config templates + validation steps)
  - “Best effort” exports: generic HTTP/OTLP endpoints (documented only; not a support promise in v1)

- Installer/Helm wiring + offline/air-gap bundle (ships):
  - Private Deployments DRI: Diego Santos
  - Ships: Helm toggles for enabling components, preflight checks (storage/network/resources), post-install validations, offline bundle manifest includes dashboards/rules/log configs.

- Validation + on-call readiness (ships runbooks + tests):
  - SRE DRI: Neha Kapoor
  - Ships: noise tuning thresholds, severity mapping aligned to paging policy, failure-injection checks, runbook links embedded in alerts.

Guardrails on cardinality (v1):
- No unbounded labels (model/route/tenant) by default.
- Aggregation/recording rules for dashboard queries; we’ll cap any “top-N” breakdown panels.
- Any per-route/per-model visibility will be opt-in and explicitly documented as potentially high-cardinality.

If this matches what you want, can you approve the staffing request as stated? Markus is looped in because SE has multiple customer asks pending and will use this for commitments.

Vivek


---

From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Aug 1, 2025 at 4:38 PM PT
Subject: Re: Approval request: Private Observability Minimum Pack — scope + resourcing + cross-team owners

Approved with the scope boundaries as you wrote them.

Resourcing approval (time-boxed):
- Telemetry/Obs Eng: approve up to 2 FTE for 6 weeks (Logan as DRI; ensure a single point of review for metric naming/cardinality).
- Private Deployments Eng: approve 1 FTE for 5 weeks (Diego as DRI for installer/Helm/offline).
- SRE: approve 0.5 FTE for 4 weeks (Neha DRI for alert philosophy/noise + validation).
- Security review: approve 0.2–0.3 FTE during implementation/validation; coordinate early so we don’t block release.

Conditions:
- v1 must ship with conservative defaults (cardinality, retention, alerting). Any “turn on everything” mode must be explicitly opt-in.
- Put the non-goals and supported-vs-documented boundaries into the customer-facing language to avoid expectation creep.
- I want a weekly status note (2–3 bullets: progress, risks, asks). If this slips, escalate early.

Markus: you can tell customers we’re committing to a supported baseline pack with tested Splunk/ELK export paths and offline packaging, with the caveats above.

Priya
